==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. I summoned my symbiote to help purge the parasites I ate. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (My slime alien symbiote suit resembles a smooth full body slimy green bodysuit.)
I asked Leon to take me to where I can find fairies. (My Ghostly UFO, named Leon, resembles a ghostly flying saucer with an ethereal green glow.)
When he took me to a black hole, I decided I didn't want to go in.
